existing_system_baseline: The first control used the existing FastAPI API, file-ledger queue, supervised lifecycle worker, real Compose Airflow data DAG with Spark, MLflow, active local CUDA model serving, Prometheus, and the local OTLP Collector.
engineering_gap_and_reason: The first fresh control completed the bounded functional path but correctly failed trace acceptance because the host serving child did not inherit OTLP configuration. It also exposed that a stale API image could report the newly injected source revision even though its copied source was older.

architecture_delta.before: The host serving child inherited an optional telemetry environment, and the API readiness source revision represented desired environment metadata rather than immutable image code identity.
architecture_delta.after: The exact serving child receives required OTLP and runtime revision bindings, the API image embeds its build revision, startup rebuilds a revision-mismatched API image, and readiness fails closed when desired and image revisions differ.
tradeoffs: Required OTLP dependencies make the bounded local production serving launch fail instead of silently losing S0 trace evidence.
Revision-aware rebuilding adds build time only when the API image label differs from repository HEAD.

implementation_delta.compatibility: The existing source_commit field remains available. Runtime source identity is additive, while readiness becomes intentionally fail-closed for stale copied API code.
implementation_delta.migration: Rebuild and recreate the existing API container, restart the scenario workload worker, and replace the exact serving process through the existing approved rollback and deployment-intent workflow before rerunning controls.

preconditions: One fresh LifecycleRun and one exact W3C trace are used for the control.
The active CUDA serving and control-plane source identities are unambiguous.
procedure: Run the real Airflow data DAG and bounded Spark stage through the existing queue and worker.
Query MLflow and send three real CUDA inference requests under the same trace.
Cancel only at the documented model-training handoff and verify terminal cleanup.
Reject the control if any required trace stage or runtime revision is absent.
stop_conditions: Any required trace stage is missing.
Desired source and executing image or serving revisions do not match.

unresolved_items: Rebuild and revision-align the API and exact CUDA serving runtime with this remediation.
Rerun one pilot and then three independent accepted controls.
Generate variance and hashed benchmark acceptance evidence.
claim_boundary: This checkpoint preserves one failed fresh control and its RCA. It proves functional traversal plus fail-closed trace rejection and 603-test remediation regression; it is not an accepted S0 benchmark, scale, availability, or production result.
